settings.heading: FAQ
settings.content:
What kind of fragrances are these?
All of our products are perfumes, which is the strongest fragrance variant available, stronger than both eau de toilette and eau de parfum.

Are your products vegan-friendly and cruelty-free?
We use exclusively vegan-friendly fragrance oils, and of course they are cruelty-free! We wouldn’t want it any other way.

Can they be safely sprayed on clothing?
Because of the higher oil content to make the fragrance last longer, we recommend, just like with all perfumes, not only those from PURE PARFUM, that you are cautious when applying them to clothing. This is, of course, at your own risk.

How should I store my fragrances?
Please note: like all fragrances, they should be kept out of direct sunlight and away from hot or cold elements. Failure to do so may affect your product.

How long does delivery take?
Orders placed before 3:00 PM are delivered within 3 business days.
